_doc: Character Level gives Stat Points. Job Level (separate EXP) gives Job Points for the Job Tree. Skill/Mod levels are raised with materials + gold. Respec costs in-game gold only.

character._critOverflowDoc: Crit chance past 100% (no cap, owner 2026-10-25) turns into crit damage: each point over adds critOverflowToMultPct to critMultPct, outside the critMultPct soft cap and cap (core/character.js derive).
character._farmDoc: goldFindPct/materialFindPct/gearFindPct (Ranger farming line, hunter arrows) raise gold, material chances and gear drop chances on kills, up to caps; they add nothing to the power score.

respec._doc: Town only. Gold only: no rare items, no real money.

movementUpgrade._doc: AGI raises movement skill ranks (owner, 2026-10-25), at the same workbench or trainer and with the same skill crystals and gold as a combat skill. Each rank above the first shortens the recharge by rechargePerLevel and lengthens the move by distancePerLevel (core/skills.js movementSkill). The skill's upgradeStat (AGI) must reach the step's requiresStat.

skillUpgrade._doc: Skill crystals + gold raise skill rank at a workbench or trainer (including town.skillUpgradeStations), at any character level (only the stat requirement and the materials gate a rank). balanceLevel is not a gate: it is the level the balance model assumes a hero reaches each rank. Mods remain the source of behaviour changes. No failure or destruction.

modUpgrade._doc: Each rank above the first raises the mod stat requirement by requiresStatPerLevel (core/skills.js modRequires); an upgrade is refused until the next rank can be met.

openWorldSimulation._doc: Idle monsters sleep outside this conservative visible-area envelope. Combat/aggro actors remain active across every authored region; rendering may enlarge the pure-rule simulationRadius for an unusually wide view.

start._doc: New characters learn only the normal attack from their selected weapon. Other combat and movement skills are acquired later from quests or crafting.

opening._doc: Wake beside the wreck and choose one weapon. Only its normal attack is learned. No combat or movement skill selection. Firebolt and Ward remain quest/workbench rewards.

combat._doc: defenseConstant: armour takes defense / (defense + defenseConstant) of a hit (core/character.js defenseFactor; it grows with the raw numbers: 2026-10-25 every raw HP/attack/defense/damage/MP value was multiplied by 10). reflectFlat: the flat part of a guard reflect. Combat feel. Consecutive melee swings within comboWindow seconds alternate the arm side (animation only; every swing is the same strike, no finisher). Non-boss monsters flinch (stop moving) for stagger seconds when hit, but a started wind-up is never cancelled.

block._doc: A shield block lets through only `taken` of a hit from within arcDeg in front of the hero. Ground hazards and hits from behind are never blocked.

power._doc: Power score = sqrt(offence x defence) x scale (core/power.js). offence = sustained damage per second of the best slotted damage skill; defence = effective HP against a frontal hit. minOffence keeps a support-only loadout from reading 0.

balance._doc: Balance model (core/balance.js, tests/core/balance-model.test.js): a reference hero per kit fights the average normal monster of its level wearing the expected gear tier. Targets are what the tuning must keep. weaponFactor follows items.handRules (sword kit dual-wields two light weapons).

targets._doc: ttk: seconds to kill a same-level normal monster (the first levels are quick on purpose); ttd: seconds a hero survives standing in its hits without dodging; hoursToCap: playtime to the monster cap fighting same-level monsters (quests add more).

farming._doc: A Ranger who takes the whole farming line and shoots hunter arrows must out-earn a same-level sword hero after paying for the arrows, but the arrows must cost a noticeable share (tests/core/balance-model.test.js).
